leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Verb System & Modals

meaningCheck.question: Function check: What is the primary purpose of using Verb System & Modals?
options: To express clear, level-appropriate meaning in structured context

meaningCheck.question: Form check: Does correct usage of Verb System & Modals require matching subject, verb, and modifier agreements?
options: No, agreement rules are optional in English

meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Accurate form and agreement choices prevent misunderstandings.

form.title: Form & Structure: Verb System & Modals
form.content: Modal verb (can, must, should, would) + base verb without 'to' (never adds -s or -ed).
